sentence: This project uses gene editing in airway progenitor cells to try to correct the defects in a gene in people with cystic fibrosis.
This project uses genetic methods to study what causes defects in cortical development, including how circuits form and work.
This project tries to find out which proteins coordinate two signaling pathways that control cell growth and proliferation.
This project studies the metabolic and molecular mechanisms that control tumor associated macrophages in glioblastoma, a brain cancer.
This project builds a nanofiber-hydrogel composite plug to promote tissue healing in perianal fistula and tests it in rodent and swine models.
This project studies how genes and molecular changes in the brain relate to post-traumatic stress disorder and its specific symptoms.
This project studies how mechanical forces and protein interactions control the actin cytoskeleton, which helps cells control their shape and movement.
This project uses neuroimaging and clinical data to study how brain features change alongside non-suicidal self-injury in adolescents.
This project builds model systems to find out how Starship transposons move genetic information between fungal microbes and affect fungal biology.
This project uses deep learning to study high-frequency oscillations, a sign of the epileptic brain, in children with epilepsy.
This project uses mass spectrometry and ion mobility analysis to measure the proteins and particle size of lipoproteins.
This project builds a knowledge graph and a data integration tool that link spatial and contextual exposome data.
This project looks for host immune signatures linked to lethality and persistence during candidemia, to understand how disseminated candidiasis develops.
This project tries to find out how loss of a histone methyltransferase promotes head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, focusing on tumor immune escape.
This project provides biostatistics support and develops methods for research on racial disparities in systemic lupus erythematosus and systemic sclerosis.
This project designs drugs that work against many coronaviruses to treat COVID-19.
This project tests a stepwise process that uses genetic sequencing and specialty referral to find and manage rare genetic causes of chronic suppurative respiratory disease.
This project develops imaging and radionuclide therapy agents that target a molecule found at high levels in multiple myeloma.
This project builds an ultrasound imaging system to detect early breast cancer and metastatic disease.
This project studies whether targeting cannabinoid receptor 2 can reduce respiratory depression caused by opioids like fentanyl, oxycodone and heroin.
